entities.name: Deborah
entities.description: A yoga teacher who met Jolene on 23 January 2023 and corresponded with her through to September 2023. She teaches yoga classes and runs mindfulness workshops and community events, lost her mother a few years before 2023 and her father on 25 January 2023, is married, keeps two cats (Luna and Max), and took up running in February 2023. She is drawn to nature, the park near her house, her mother's old house and the nearby beach where she was married.

entities.name: Jolene
entities.description: An engineering student who met Deborah on 23 January 2023. She finished an electrical engineering project in January 2023, completed a university robotics project in May 2023, then interned at an engineering firm and worked on an aerial-surveillance prototype. She has been with her partner for three years as of February 2023, keeps two snakes (Susie and Seraphim), plays video games, and has practised yoga and meditation for about three years.

entities.name: Deborah's mother

properties.aliases: my mom; my mum; her mother

entities.description: Deborah's mother, who died a few years before January 2023. She married Deborah's father in 1993, loved reading by the window of her house, travelled, was interested in art, loved flowers and cooking, sang lullabies, and often came to Deborah's early yoga classes with her. Her cat Max went to Deborah when she died. Referred to throughout only as "my mom".

entities.name: Deborah's father
entities.description: Deborah's father, who died suddenly on 25 January 2023. He married Deborah's mother in 1993. Referred to only as "my dad".

entities.name: Deborah's husband
entities.description: Deborah's husband, never named. They married on the beach near her home, used to play video games together (detective games in particular) and enjoy the outdoors together. Deborah said in January 2023 that love and openness had kept them close.

entities.name: Jolene's mother
entities.description: Jolene's mother, who died in 2022. She gave Jolene a heart-shaped pendant in Paris in 2010, played video games with her (Monster Hunter: World among them), and taught her never to give up — a value Jolene carries into her engineering work.

entities.name: Jolene's partner

properties.aliases: my partner; my bf; my boyfriend

entities.description: Jolene's partner, never named. They met in an engineering class at college, were friends first, and had been together three years as of February 2023; they are not married. They play video games together, work on engineering projects together, and he joined her for yoga from early 2023. They travelled to Rio de Janeiro in August 2023 and to a meditation retreat in Phuket in September 2023.

entities.name: Anna
entities.description: Deborah's neighbour, whom she met at yoga in the park on 31 January 2023. They bonded over yoga, both wear a pendant in memory of their mothers, went biking together, started a running group together in July 2023, and ran a free community gardening class on 16 September 2023.

entities.name: Karlie
entities.description: A friend of Deborah's who died in the week before 22 February 2023. The last photograph of the two of them was taken in the summer of 2022 on a hike together. Deborah spent time in a garden after the loss to find comfort.

entities.name: Neal Stephenson
entities.description: The author Jolene named as the writer of "Avalanche", the book she read in one sitting about two weeks before 4 February 2023.

entities.name: Susie
entities.description: One of Jolene's two pet snakes, adopted about two years before August 2023 when she was feeling lonely and wanted company; she said on 15 September 2023 she had had her for two years. Jolene introduced her to Deborah on 27 January 2023 and said Susie helped her cope after losing her project work in July 2023.

entities.name: Seraphim
entities.description: Jolene's second pet snake, bought in Paris about a year before January 2023. She once slid out of her cage and coiled up beside Jolene during a video-game session; Jolene took her to the park on 26 February 2023 and bought her a new aquarium on 24 June 2023.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: One of Deborah's two cats, taken from a shelter, five years old as of 26 August 2023. Deborah takes her cats out to the park every morning and evening.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Deborah's other cat, eight years old as of 26 August 2023. He was her mother's cat and Deborah took him in when her mother died.

entities.name: Deborah's mother's old house

properties.aliases: my mother's old house; my mom's house; my old home

entities.description: The house Deborah's late mother lived in, which Deborah visits repeatedly through the conversation — in the week before 23 January 2023, in July 2023 and on 10 September 2023. It has a bench by the window where her mother sat every morning and read every night, a spot by the water nearby, and a yoga retreat Deborah attended in August 2023 was near it. Deborah also practises yoga there.

entities.name: The park near Deborah's house

properties.aliases: a nearby park; the park; my favorite nature spot

entities.description: A park close to Deborah's home with a forest trail and a beach. It holds a bench where she and her mother used to sit and talk about dreams and life, which she revisited in August 2023. She jogged there for the first time on 24 February 2023, takes her cats there morning and evening, and does yoga and reflects there.

entities.name: The beach near Deborah's home
entities.description: A beach near Deborah's home, which she named as a favourite nature spot in February 2023, described in August 2023 as part of the park near her house, and said in September 2023 is where she got married and discovered her love of surfing. Treated here as one place because every mention is of a single beach close to her home; she also does yoga there.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city where Jolene's mother gave her the heart-shaped pendant in 2010, and where Jolene bought her snake Seraphim about a year before January 2023.

entities.name: Bali
entities.description: An island Deborah travelled to in 2022 and named as one of her favourite places — gorgeous, peaceful and good for yoga.

entities.name: Bogota
entities.description: Where Jolene holidayed in the summer of 2022 and photographed a sunset over the water she found beautiful and calming.

entities.name: Rio de Janeiro
entities.description: The city Jolene and her partner travelled to, returning on 29 August 2023, where they tried yoga classes, visited cafes, went on many excursions and saw an old temple. Deborah had also been there in 2020.

entities.name: Phuket
entities.description: Where Jolene and her partner travelled in the weekend of 9-10 September 2023 for a meditation retreat lasting a few weeks.

entities.name: Thailand
entities.description: The country containing Phuket, where Jolene and her partner went on a meditation retreat in September 2023 and tried a new style of meditation with flowers.

entities.name: Mount Talkeetna
entities.description: The mountain on top of which Jolene did yoga on the morning of 5 June 2023.

entities.name: Deborah's yoga classes and workshops

properties.aliases: my classes; the group; my yoga class; the neighborhood yoga class; my workshops and events

entities.description: The yoga Deborah teaches and the community around it, treated as one thing across the conversation: classes she was already teaching before January 2023 (whose members sent her a thank-you letter on 26 January 2023), yoga in the park, the neighbourhood class she began hosting on 10 March 2023, the mindfulness and self-care workshops she organises, and a yoga event with food stalls and live music she organised in July 2023. She bought new props and a candle for it in March 2023 and calls the people in it a second family.

entities.name: Deborah and Anna's running group
entities.description: A running group Deborah started with her neighbour Anna, first mentioned on 9 July 2023. Its members help and push each other during runs, which Deborah says makes it much easier to stay motivated.

entities.name: Jolene's engineering school

properties.aliases: engineering school; college; my studies; my classes

entities.description: The university where Jolene studies engineering, never named. Her professor set the robotics project in February 2023; she met her partner in an engineering class there; exams, assignments and deadlines there are a recurring source of stress, and she had finals coming up in September 2023.

entities.name: The engineering firm where Jolene interned
entities.description: A well-known engineering firm, never named, where Jolene was interning as of 6 June 2023. She said the best part was applying what she had learned at school to real projects, that it stoked her love of engineering, and that work-life balance there was hard.

entities.name: Jolene's electrical engineering project
entities.description: An electrical engineering project Jolene finished in the week before 23 January 2023 after a lot of work — the first thing she told Deborah about. Kept separate from the water purifier she reported a milestone on a week later, because the two are described in different weeks as different accomplishments; they may be the same work.

entities.name: Jolene's sustainable water purifier
entities.description: A sustainable water purifier Jolene designed and built for a rural community in need, a milestone she reached in the week before 4 February 2023 after a lot of planning and research. Seeing it deliver clean water gave her a sense of purpose.

entities.name: Jolene's university robotics project
entities.description: The large robotics project Jolene's engineering professor set her class, first described on 1 February 2023 and completed in May 2023, the result being a solar-powered vehicle. Taken to be the same work as "my engineering project" at her February retreat, the breakthrough on 24 March 2023 and the "big project" she reported in April 2023, because the dates and the description of a long tough project run continuously from February to May.

entities.name: Jolene's aerial surveillance prototype
entities.description: A prototype Jolene was working on as of 12 August 2023, intended to be a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system for emergency response and environmental monitoring. Still tough but progressing on 6 September 2023.

entities.name: Jolene's STEM volunteer programme idea
entities.description: A volunteer programme Jolene proposed on 9 February 2023 in which engineers would teach STEM to underprivileged children, run as workshops with local schools and centres and with engineers as guest speakers. She had sketched it in her planner but had approached nobody, wanting to solidify the plan first.

entities.name: Deborah's community cleanup project
entities.description: A cleanup project for her community that Deborah had just started and was raising funds for as of 1 August 2023; she was pleased to see people come together for it.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: The practice at the centre of the conversation. Deborah teaches it, having taken it up when it helped her through a rough time, and practises it at home, at her mother's old house, in the park, on the beach and on retreats. Jolene has practised it sporadically for about three years and uses it against study stress; her partner joined her from early 2023 and Anna practises it with Deborah.

entities.name: Meditation
entities.description: Practised by both women alongside yoga. Part of Deborah's morning routine and of the workshops she runs; she made a meditation guide for her yoga retreat in August 2023 and recommended mindful breathing to Jolene. Jolene credits it with keeping her calm after losing her work files, and went on a meditation retreat in Phuket in September 2023.

entities.name: Video gaming
entities.description: Jolene's long-standing hobby, begun when her parents gave her a console at ten and taught to herself; she plays with her partner constantly and they bet on games. Deborah used to play with her husband, preferring detective games, but had not for a while as of August 2023.

entities.name: Running
entities.description: Deborah went for a morning jog in a nearby park for the first time on 24 February 2023 and made it part of her daily routine; by July 2023 she had started a running group with Anna.

entities.name: Surfing
entities.description: Deborah discovered her love of surfing at the beach where she got married. Jolene wanted to learn from March 2023 onwards, gathering information and a beginners' guide, but as of 17 September 2023 had still not gone; the two agreed to go together in October 2023.

entities.name: Sapiens
entities.description: The book Jolene was reading in February 2023, which she called a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us.

entities.name: Avalanche
entities.description: A book Jolene attributed to Neal Stephenson and read in one sitting about two weeks before 4 February 2023.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The console game Jolene and her partner played together in the week before 27 January 2023.

entities.name: The Walking Dead
entities.description: The game Jolene and her partner planned to play on 28 January 2023.

entities.name: It Takes Two
entities.description: The favourite game of Jolene and her partner as of July 2023 — a competitive team-strategy game they use to bond.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
entities.description: An open-world Switch game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023.

entities.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
entities.description: A game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023 as calming and cute.

entities.name: Overcooked 2
entities.description: A chaotic co-op cooking game Jolene and her partner often play for bets; she once won three large pizzas on it.

entities.name: Battlefield 1
entities.description: The console game Jolene and her partner were given in the week before 21 August 2023.

entities.name: Monster Hunter: World
entities.description: One of Jolene's favourite games to play with her mother, loved for its immersive story and open world, and a way for her to de-stress.

entities.name: Sleep
entities.description: The album Deborah was listening to in March 2023 and recommended to Jolene as good for meditation and deep relaxation.

entities.name: Savana
entities.description: An instrumental track Deborah named on 28 March 2023 as one of her favourites for creating a peaceful vibe during yoga.

entities.name: Jolene's heart-shaped pendant
entities.description: A heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it that Jolene's mother gave her in Paris in 2010. Its symbol represents freedom to Jolene and reminds her to go for her goals and not be held back.

entities.name: Deborah's amulet from her mother
entities.description: A pendant or amulet of her mother's that Deborah keeps as a reminder of her, and brings with her to the spot by the water near her mother's old house so she can feel her mother's love.
